# Breadcrumb toolbar omits aria-current="page" and Depth-2 VDOM sync

Owned by `@neo-gemini-julia` for Engine v14 delivery (paired with the reactive `ariaCurrent_` button config follow-up, excluding curated contributor labels per `ticket-create` §4).

## Context

`Neo.toolbar.Breadcrumb` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs`) renders hierarchical route crumbs using `ntype: 'button'` items (`route: item.route`, rendering `<a>` links). Currently, `updateItems()` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs:189-230`) marks the active trailing crumb only with `disabled: i === len - 1`, exposes no WAI-ARIA breadcrumb landmark or `aria-current="page"` state, and mutates reused crumb instances silently while calling `me.update()` at `updateDepth: 1`.

## The Problem

1. **Missing `aria-current="page"` & Breadcrumb landmark semantics:** Assistive technology hears a generic `<div>` of links with no `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark and no `aria-current="page"` on the active destination (`disabled: true` on a route `<a>` button only toggles `.neo-disabled` per `Neo.button.Base#syncNativeDisabledState`, leaving screen readers unaware which link represents the current page).
2. **Silent reused-item updates dropped at `updateDepth: 1`:** In `Breadcrumb#updateItems()` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs:198-230`), existing items `items[i]` are updated via `items[i].setSilent(config)` (and surplus items via `items[i].setSilent({hidden: true})`) while `me.silentVdomUpdate = true`, followed by `me.update()` at line `229` with `Toolbar`'s default `updateDepth = 1`. Because `setSilent` leaves `item.needsVdomUpdate = false` and does not register in `VDomUpdate.mergedCallbackMap`, a mounted `Breadcrumb` switching `activeKey` diffs only its Depth-1 container shell (placeholder references) unless `me.updateDepth = 2; me.denseUpdate = true` is set before `me.update()`.
3. **Null-store / missing-parent guards:** `afterSetActiveKey` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs:94`) evaluates `me.store.getCount?.()` without optional chaining on `me.store` (throwing if `activeKey` is set before a `store` exists), and `getPathItems()` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs:148-154`) dereferences `item.parentId` without guarding an unknown `activeKey` (`store.get(parentId)` returning `null`).

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: WAI-ARIA 1.2 Breadcrumb Pattern (`<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark + `aria-current="page"` on the current page link) and `Neo.mixin.VdomLifecycle` dense subtree contract (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:406-408`, `src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:237-250`).

- `Breadcrumb` extends `Neo.toolbar.Base` (`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs:10`), inheriting `_vdom: {cls: ...}` (`tag: 'div'` by default) and `updateDepth: 1`.
- Setting `ariaLabel_: 'Breadcrumb'` (or root `'aria-label'` via a reactive `ariaLabel_` config) and `_vdom: {tag: 'nav', cn: []}` (or `tag: 'nav'` config on `Neo.component.Base`) turns `Breadcrumb` into a proper navigation landmark without `role="toolbar"`.
- Once `Neo.button.Base#ariaCurrent_` lands, `Breadcrumb#updateItems()` can pass `ariaCurrent: i === len - 1 ? 'page' : null` in each crumb's `config` object and flush reused items atomically in one worker round-trip via `me.updateDepth = 2; me.denseUpdate = true; me.update()`.
- **Structural Pre-Flight:** New unit spec `test/playwright/unit/toolbar/Breadcrumb.spec.mjs` matches sibling `test/playwright/unit/toolbar/Paging.spec.mjs` and `KeyboardNavigation.spec.mjs` (Stage 1 fast-path).

## The Fix

1. **`src/toolbar/Breadcrumb.mjs`:**
   - Configure `tag: 'nav'` and reactive `ariaLabel_: 'Breadcrumb'` (`afterSetAriaLabel` -> `this.changeVdomRootKey('aria-label', value)`).
   - In `updateItems()`, include `ariaCurrent: i === len - 1 ? 'page' : null` on active path items and `ariaCurrent: null` when hiding trailing items (`items[i].setSilent({ariaCurrent: null, hidden: true})`).
   - Before `me.update()` at the end of `updateItems()`, set `me.updateDepth = 2; me.denseUpdate = true` so silent mutations on reused child buttons ship in one atomic VDOM update.
   - Guard `me.store?.getCount?.() > 0` in `afterSetActiveKey` and break cleanly if `store.get(parentId)` is nullish in `getPathItems()`.
2. **Unit Tests (`test/playwright/unit/toolbar/Breadcrumb.spec.mjs`):**
   - Verify `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` root semantics, `aria-current="page"` on the last crumb only, live VDOM delta propagation across `activeKey` transitions (deeper path, shallower path hiding surplus crumbs, sibling switch reusing existing button instances), and safe handling when `activeKey` is set before `store` or with an unknown key.

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `Neo.toolbar.Breadcrumb` renders a `<nav>` root with configurable `ariaLabel_` (default `'Breadcrumb'`) and marks only the active trailing crumb button with `aria-current="page"`.
- [ ] AC-2: Switching `activeKey` on a mounted `Breadcrumb` (longer trail, shorter trail, and same-depth sibling trail reusing existing `Neo.button.Base` instances) updates rendered child VNodes (`text`, `href`, `aria-current`, `removeDom`) in a single parent batch without stale reused-button DOM state.
- [ ] AC-3: Setting `activeKey` before `store` is populated or to an unknown key does not throw; `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/toolbar/Breadcrumb.spec.mjs` passes.

## Out of Scope

- Visual separator glyphs or CSS restyling of `.neo-breadcrumb-toolbar`.
